title: ChIPseqSpikeInFree-bigwig-nf pipeline parameters
description: Spike-in free ChIP-seq scaling factors with ChIPseqSpikeInFree, from bigWig coverage tracks

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a CSV/TSV samplesheet with columns sample, bigwig, antibody, group and optional color and reads.
input.help_text: One row per bigWig (local path or http(s)/ftp URL). All rows are analysed together in one ChIPseqSpikeInFree run, so include every sample that should be comparable. The bigWig must be a non-negative coverage track of duplicate-removed, unique reads; a constant per-sample scaling (RPM, spike-in factor) is fine, input-subtracted or log-ratio tracks are not.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

cohort.description: Cohort name, used as prefix for all output files.

bigwig_binning_options.title: bigWig binning options
bigwig_binning_options.description: Options for summing bigWig signal in genome-wide bins (changing them re-runs CSIF_BIN_BIGWIG).

genome.description: Genome whose chromosome sizes are used to build bins. Ignored when --chrom_sizes is given.

chrom_sizes.description: Custom chrom.sizes file (two tab-separated columns: chromosome, length) for other genomes.

pseudo_depth.description: Pseudo read total per sample, used when the samplesheet has no 'reads' column.
pseudo_depth.help_text: ChIPseqSpikeInFree divides each sample by its own total, so this number cancels; it only has to exceed the 1e6-read cut-off of the method. Give the real read counts in a 'reads' column to apply that cut-off to real library sizes.

approx_summary.description: Allow zoom-level summaries when reading bigWigs (faster for remote files, approximate).

scaling_factor_options.title: Scaling factor options
scaling_factor_options.description: Calibration options (changing them re-runs only CSIF_SCALE from the parsed matrix).

min_first_turn.description: Fraction of noisy reads excluded before estimating the first turning point (0.2-0.8). Default: auto.

max_last_turn.description: Fraction of reads used to estimate the last turning point (0.90-0.99). Try 0.97 for broad marks such as H3K9me3.

cutoff_qc.description: QC cutoff for failed or poorly enriched samples (0.90-1.20); smaller is looser. Try 1 for H3K9me3.

xmax.description: x-axis maximum of the distribution plot. Default: automatic.

software_options.title: Software options
software_options.description: Container used by the ChIPseqSpikeInFree processes.

chipseqspikeinfree_container.description: Docker image or local .sif file with R, ChIPseqSpikeInFree, Python and pybigtools (see containers/chipseqspikeinfree-bigwig/Dockerfile).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
